description: Source file implementing JSON serialization and deserialization handlers for Open vSwitch (OVS) map and related data structures in C. Contains functions for converting various map types (string, integer, boolean, real, UUID) to and from JSON format, as well as handling specific OVS map representations like smap, dmap, and their subtypes.
